title: 英语和普通话中的居高临下与屈尊语言检测
summary: 本文提出自动检测居高临下与屈尊语言（PCL）的系统，比较了静态词嵌入加CNN与微调BERT两种方法，后者在开发集上取得0.528的F1分数。
summary_en: This paper proposes systems for automated detection of patronizing and condescending language (PCL), comparing static word embeddings with a CNN against fine-tuned BERT; the latter achieved an F1 score of 0.528 on the development set.
